### Principles

Stances Orbit holds across features, with the reason and the cost, one page each under
`docs/principles/`. Admission and page shape: [principle conventions](./principles/CONVENTIONS.md).

| Principle | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [Orbit Data Handling](./principles/data-handling.md) | Orbit Data Handling — what stays on your machine, what leaves it, and to whom |
| [Declared Footprints](./principles/declared-footprints.md) | Declared footprints: a task declares the files it will touch, and Orbit runs tasks in parallel only when those footprints do not overlap |
| [Operator Admission](./principles/operator-admission.md) | Operator admission: agents propose work and the operator controls its admission and authority |
| [Optimistic Merging](./principles/optimistic-merging.md) | Optimistic Merging: Orbit's preferred delivery mode. Merge fast, review after landing, keep the queue draining |
| [Pilot Before Promote](./principles/pilot-before-promote.md) | Pilot before promote: a task is checked against the current code before it enters the backlog, and the pilot holds it when the brief contradicts the tree |
| [Orbit Positioning](./principles/positioning.md) | Orbit Positioning |

### Lessons

Lessons learned while building Orbit, one file each under `docs/lessons/`. They may not
apply to everyone or in every case, but they shaped some of the decisions we made.

| Lesson | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [L01. Tool surface decides which fight your tool has to win](./lessons/L01-tool-surface-decides-which-fight-your-tool-has-to-win.md) | A specialized tool wins use only where it does not compete with familiar primitives; the access surface, not the backend, decides it. |
| [L02. The May 2026 Artifact Loss Incident](./lessons/L02-may-2026-artifact-loss-incident.md) | Backup and recovery are not optional for long-lived artifacts. |
| [L03. The September 2026 Test Fixture Fork Storm](./lessons/L03-september-2026-test-fixture-fork-storm.md) | Bound test synchronization, reap every spawned child on every exit path, and contain descendants at the sandbox as a separate layer. |
| [L04. A measurement protocol can make a task impossible](./lessons/L04-a-measurement-protocol-can-make-a-task-impossible.md) | Price a task's measurement protocol before dispatch, and give the implementer a way out when the harness, not the change, is what fails. |

## Runbooks

Each runbook is scoped to one goal or tightly coupled failure mode.
Update the source runbook when
CLI behavior, state layout, or recovery semantics change.

### Operate Orbit

| Runbook | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Inspect the Audit Trail](./runbooks/audit-trail.md) | Query and interpret Orbit invocation, run, step, and activity audit history. |
| [Verify and Recover Claimed-Review Artifacts](./runbooks/claimed-review-artifacts.md) | Verify and recover a distributed-drain follower's before-PR reviewer, whose review-artifact reads and report write reach the owner through the run's coordinator instead of SSH inside the sandbox. |
| [Recover a Corrupted Database](./runbooks/database-recovery.md) | Recover a corrupted Orbit SQLite database from backup, salvage, or regeneration. |
| [Set Up and Recover a Single-Owner Distributed Drain](./runbooks/distributed-drain.md) | Set up, migrate, run, and recover a single-owner distributed drain — follower pull with owner-only landing, no follower merges. |
| [Onboard an Executor](./runbooks/executor-onboarding.md) | Add and validate a CLI-agent or deterministic local-shell executor without changing existing users' routing or state. |
| [Evaluate a forecast cohort](./runbooks/forecast-accuracy.md) | Select a forecast cohort, compare raw and attributed errors, and distinguish idle, partial and missing measurements without changing host policy. |
| [Check Orbit Health](./runbooks/health-checks.md) | Check Orbit workspace, database, dashboard, log-sink, job-run, and routine-clock health. |
| [Linux sandbox onboarding and diagnostics](./runbooks/linux-sandbox.md) | Explain automatic Linux Bubblewrap onboarding, distro eligibility, readiness, and native validation status. |
| [Inspect and Retain Logs](./runbooks/logging.md) | Locate, filter, rotate, and retain Orbit process and routine-sweep logs. |
| [Operate the Review Gate](./runbooks/review-gate.md) | Inspect before-PR and before-landing review verdicts, findings, and evidence holds, then decide how to resume a task. |
| [Inventory and Protect Orbit State](./runbooks/state-and-backup.md) | Locate Orbit state and perform WAL-safe backups, explicit task publication, restores, and task migrations. |
| [Recover Stuck Job Runs](./runbooks/stuck-job-runs.md) | Diagnose, cancel, resume, or replay pending and running Orbit job runs. |
| [Publish Orbit Tasks to a Dedicated Repository](./runbooks/task-publication.md) | Bind, authenticate, publish, verify, inspect, and recover an Orbit task-publication repository. |
| [Upgrade Orbit Safely](./runbooks/upgrades.md) | Install a new Orbit release with `orbit update`, then review, apply, and verify workspace-layout and store-schema migrations safely, including what an older binary may still do with a newer workspace. |
| [Run Orbit on Windows through WSL2](./runbooks/windows-wsl2.md) | Run Orbit on Windows inside a WSL2 Linux distribution, with sandbox, MCP, clock and filesystem limits and an explicit not-verified-on-Windows matrix. |
| [Reclaim kept worktree output](./runbooks/worktree-reclaim.md) | Reclaim declared rebuildable outputs from kept terminal run worktrees and their host validation output. |
